track.title: Afshari: Daramad III
track.notes: Open: the suite's finalis is unsettled: Daramads I, II, V vote E, Daramads III, IV, VI, VII vote B, the Forud votes F#. Vote kept.

progression.narrative: The performance opens on F#4 and dwells most on F# in Daramad III. The line peaks at G#4 (425.3 Hz) at 0:19.5. It closes on E4, not the tonic (E4 → F#4 → E4 → E4 → E4 → E4).
